name: Tomika (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tomika town emblem in white: a stylised bird-like device with a hooked head and a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Tomika, a town in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Tomika town emblem — a stylised bird-like device with a hooked head and a ring
